title: Daily PeKaB40 Health Screenings by State
description: Daily healthcare screenings conducted under the PeKaB40 program, at state level. The table provides a preview of the dataset using the most recent year of data.

fields.name: screenings
fields.title: Screenings
fields.description: [Integer] Number of health screenings conducted on that date

methodology: This dataset is produced from the transactional database operated by Protect Health Corporation to administer the PeKaB40 program. PeKa B40 is a MoH initiative which aims to sustain the healthcare needs of low income groups by focusing on non-communicable diseases (NCDs). Recipients of government cash assistance and their spouses aged 40 and above are automatically eligible for free health screenings.
publication: KKMNOW features a [dashboard on Peka B40](https://data.moh.gov.my/dashboard/peka-b40) where you can explore the data in a more interactive manner!
